title: Hypnos: Learning Generalisable Representations of Sleep Physiology via Next-Token Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2606.09605v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Foundation models offer a promising route to compress multi-modal physiological signals into compact representations of human health, with broad applications across sleep medicine, cardiology, neurology and other healthcare domains. Existing models have typically been trained with masked-reconstruction or contrastive objectives. However, masked reconstruction may be poorly suited to the stochastic nature of these signals, while contrastive approaches rely on positive-pair definitions despite the semantic invariances of physiological signals being poorly understood. In this work, we show that next-token prediction is a simple and scalable alternative. We develop Hypnos, a multi-modal sleep foundation model trained using eight different sensing modalities (e.g. EEG, ECG, respiratory signals) drawn from over 20{,}000 overnight polysomnography recordings. translated_title: Hypnos：通过下一词元预测学习睡眠生理的可泛化表征
translated_abstract: 基础模型为将多模态生理信号压缩为紧凑的人类健康表征提供了一条富有前景的路径，在睡眠医学、心脏病学、神经病学及其他医疗健康领域具有广泛应用。现有模型通常采用掩码重建或对比学习目标进行训练。然而，掩码重建可能难以适应这些信号的随机特性，而对比学习方法依赖于正样本对的定义，尽管生理信号的语义不变性尚缺乏充分理解。在本工作中，我们证明了下一词元预测是一种简单且可扩展的替代方案。我们开发了Hypnos，一个多模态睡眠基础模型，利用来自超过20,000份整夜多导睡眠图记录的八种不同传感模态（如脑电图、心电图、呼吸信号）进行训练。我们使用残差向量量化将每种模态标记化为离散词元流……
tldr: 该论文提出Hypnos多模态睡眠基础模型，以下一词元预测作为掩码重建和对比学习的简单可扩展替代方案，从超过2万份多导睡眠图记录的八种传感模态中学习睡眠生理信号的可泛化表征。
en_tdlr: The paper presents Hypnos, a multi-modal sleep foundation model trained via next-token prediction on eight sensing modalities from over 20,000 polysomnography recordings, demonstrating that next-token prediction is a simple and scalable alternative to masked reconstruction and contrastive objectives for learning generalisable representations of sleep physiology.
